attempt: Two attacks: (a) the last sentence, that clause availability in the File Section's record description entries depends on the implemented Nucleus level, which the Nucleus paragraph §1985:VI.5.2.3 p1 does not carry; (b) VI.5.2.3 sits under Working-Storage, so its definition of a record description might not reach the Sequential I-O File Section.
reason: Both fail. (b) Apart from 'with' for 'within', sentences 1-4 are the same words as VI.5.2.3 p1, and that definition is generic ('a particular record'). VII.3.1's format names the same record-description-entry, so the scope is the same. (a) The sentence's obligation is the level boxing of the Nucleus data description format on page VI-20, the folio of 1985-FMT-VI.5.3.2 (box part: Formats 2/3 and the KEY phrases are level-2 boxed). The boxing goes wherever that entry is used, the File Section included. The sentence states nothing the format does not, as 1985-SR-X.4.3.3-1 says in the same words for IPC.
quoted: The availability of specific clauses in the data description entry is dependent on the level of Nucleus module supported by the implementation
